responsibility: Provides the CR16 target configuration header that binds GCC’s generic backend interfaces to this architecture’s ABI, register file, storage layout, assembler syntax, and code-generation conventions. It defines preprocessor builtins, type sizes and alignments, register numbering and fixed/call-used sets, elimination and argument-passing macros, addressing and PIC properties, section/directive formatting, jump-table emission, and other target macros that govern how the compiler models CR16 data, functions, and assembly output.
same_name_distinction: This is the CR16 target configuration header of compile-time macros and declarations. It fixes ABI properties, register layout, data sizes, assembler conventions, and preprocessor builtins for the port, whereas cr16.c provides the runtime hook implementations behind many of those interfaces, cr16.md provides the instruction patterns, and cr16.opt defines selectable command-line options.
